title: MSC4500 Homomorphic LtHash Cryptography, BLAKE3 XOF & AES-CTR Profile

primary_concerns: High (Missing Guards): LtHash::seed intentionally skips cryptographic and syntactic validation of Matrix Event IDs on the hot hashing path, delegating structural validation to caller ingestion boundaries while Tier-2 validation (src/auth/validate.rs) in docs/homeserver_utilities.md remains unimplemented.

Moderate (Algebraic & Crypto Profile Separation): In docs/gf128_widening_analysis.md and docs/perf_audits.md, Path B (non-interfering fork skip via LtHash digest) was rejected as a correctness cliff equivalent to CDO; Path A (identical-fork fast path) requires structural equality fallback (ptr_eq || ==) and strict domain separation between BLAKE3 XOF (msc4500:lthash16:blake3:v1) and the gomatrixcrypto AES-256-CTR profile.
